notes: B-49 follow-up #1 (was branch chandra_heart_of_fire:01). The [−9] (idx 2): 'Search your graveyard and library for any number of red instant and/or sorcery cards, exile them, then shuffle. You may cast them this turn. Add six {R}.' It finds the lone red sorcery Crash Through in the graveyard and exiles it ('any number' is asked pick by pick with a NONE stop, CR 107.1c; the pack picks the one card), and adds six {R} (10 -> 16). 'You may cast them this turn' compiles since round 13 (a permission, which cards/M21/chandra_heart_of_fire_minus_nine_* cast through), but this pack casts nothing, so Crash Through stays exiled and no card is drawn.
